name: @xpert-ai/plugin-factory-operations
description: Independent-Assistant factory anomaly investigation, recovery approval, execution, verification, and management monitoring.
author: XpertAI

interface.longDescription: Coordinate evidence-backed equipment, quality, production, and resource analysis; compare deterministic recovery plans; require revision-bound human approval; capture execution confirmations; and verify production recovery.
defaultPrompt: 请研判当前 M-07 严重异常，并并行协调设备、质量、生产和资源 Agent。
请读取这个工厂事件的最新进度，说明阻塞项和下一步。
方案 B 已经批准，请检查执行确认并完成恢复验证。

displayName.zh_Hans: 工厂智能运营与异常恢复中心

description.en_US: Investigate anomalies, review recovery plans, and track production recovery with evidence.
description.zh_Hans: 协同研判生产异常、审批恢复方案，并追踪恢复结果与证据。

name.zh_Hans: 工厂智能运营与异常恢复

description.en_US: Organization-shared workspace for factory recovery monitoring and the independent Assistant suite.
description.zh_Hans: 用于工厂异常恢复监控与独立 Assistant 套件的组织共享工作空间。

tagline.en_US: See the risk. Coordinate the recovery. Prove the result.
tagline.zh_Hans: 看清风险，协同恢复，验证结果。

longDescription.en_US: Bring equipment, quality, production and resource evidence into one recovery process. Project Pipelines track execution and history; people approve revision-bound plans. The default environment uses simulated equipment and execution confirmations.
longDescription.zh_Hans: 汇集设备、质量、生产与资源证据，通过项目任务流水线追踪执行和历史轮次，由人工审批当前修订的恢复方案。默认使用设备与执行确认的仿真环境。

description.en_US: Eight specialist Assistants coordinate anomaly triage, diagnostics, impact analysis, planning and verification.
description.zh_Hans: 八位专业助理分工完成异常研判、设备诊断、影响分析、方案规划与恢复验证。

description.en_US: Follow execution records and historical rounds in Project Tasks. Approval is bound to the current plan revision.
description.zh_Hans: 在项目任务中查看执行记录与历史轮次；人工审批绑定当前方案修订。

description.en_US: Inspect recovery trends, blocked work and evidence for each Factory Case.
description.zh_Hans: 查看恢复趋势、受阻任务，并下钻到具体 Factory Case 的业务证据。

dataScope.en_US: Application data stays within the current organization; case work follows Project access controls. The default simulation does not operate production equipment.
dataScope.zh_Hans: 应用数据限定在当前组织内，案例操作遵循项目访问权限；默认仿真不操作生产设备。

initializationSummary.en_US: Create a shared workspace and publish the read-only management Assistant. An administrator deploys the operational role suite separately before starting case pipelines.
initializationSummary.zh_Hans: 创建组织共享工作空间并发布只读管理助理。开展案例流水线前，需由管理员另行部署运营角色套件。

initializationSteps.zh_Hans: 创建专用组织工作空间。

initializationSteps.en_US: Install and publish the management Assistant.

description.en_US: Persist evidence-backed specialist findings.
description.zh_Hans: 持久化带证据的专业研判结论。

description.en_US: Authorize a revision-bound recovery plan.
description.zh_Hans: 审批与修订号绑定的恢复方案。

description.en_US: Inspect execution confirmations and recovery evidence.
description.zh_Hans: 检查执行确认和恢复证据。
